decisions.reason: Locates partial/runningCalls/turnEnds reads and gives a substantive projection-vs-immediate split, but the mechanism is invented (state.busy/turns.endReason/useSnapshot/useStream, compat namespace) — no chat legacy projection or views/timeline target access.

Locates the removed dsh-client-runtime import in Pet.tsx and the client.inject entry, and avoids claiming cordis exports everything, but never repoints ClientContext to scoped cordis or snapshot types to a target owner (target path left as unconfirmed same-package).
Locates the scoped slots.register at index.ts:38-43 and preserves name/id/order, notes the undeclared-slot throw, but omits slots.inject wrapping and the ui-renderer client Context/service ownership.
Sequencing plan separates projection from immediate type/inject work, but card numbering is admitted reconstructed and never ties to the real DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 session-view split.
